items.title: Pneuma: A Large-Scale Real-World Time Series Benchmark for Commercial Aircraft Predictive Maintenance
items.title_zh: Pneuma：一个用于商用飞机预测性维护的大规模真实世界时间序列基准
items.summary_zh: 预测性维护对商业航空至关重要，然而进展仍因缺乏公开、大规模真实世界数据集而受阻。因此，大多数方法在专有数据上开发和评估，限制了可重复性。我们推出Pneuma，这是第一个公开可用的大规模基准，使用在役商用飞机的机载时间序列进行预测性维护。Pneuma围绕引气系统构建，包含跨四种飞机类型和9个已验证故障场景的超过9.2亿个多变量时间步，直接与实际维护日志对齐。该数据集展现了关键现实世界挑战，包括显著的类别不平衡、微妙的故障演化模式以及飞机配置间的显著差异。我们围绕三个任务构建基准：多变量预测、监督故障分类和无监督异常检测，标签来自实际维护记录。在统一设置下，我们在9个精心策划的子集上评估了来自四个方法家族的25个以上模型。结果表明，即使强大的当代模型也难以应对微妙的故障特征。进一步分析显示，额外的上下文示例和多变量推理带来一致增益，而预测质量与异常检测性能强烈相关。总之，这些发现为有效建模复杂

extra.description: Predictive maintenance is vital for commercial aviation, yet progress remains hindered by the lack of public, large-scale real-world datasets. As a result, most methods are developed and evaluated on proprietary data, limiting reproducibility. We introduce Pneuma, the first publicly available large-scale benchmark for predictive maintenance using onboard time series from in-service commercial aircraft. Built around bleed air systems, Pneuma contains over 920 million multivariate time steps across four aircraft types and 9 verified fault scenarios, directly aligned with real maintenance logs. The dataset exhibits key real-world challenges, including substantial class imbalance, subtle fault evolution patterns, and significant variance across aircraft configurations. We structure the benchmark around three tasks: multivariate forecasting, supervised fault classification, and unsupervised anomaly detection, with labels derived from actual maintenance records. Under unified settings, we evaluate over 25 models from four methodological families on 9 carefully curated subsets. The results reveal that even strong contemporary models struggle with subtle fault signatures. Further analyses show consistent gains from additional in-context examples and multivariate inference, while forecasting quality is strongly associated with anomaly detection performance. Together, these findings provide practical insights into effectively modeling complex real-world aviation time series. We hope Pneuma will serve as a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing data-driven predictive maintenance toward real-world deployment in commercial aviation.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: When uncertainty quantification fails: structural vulnerabilities and corrections for selective prediction under clinical class imbalance
items.title_zh: 当不确定性量化失败时：临床类别不平衡下选择性预测的结构脆弱性和修正
items.summary_zh: 背景。选择性预测系统通过将模糊病例推迟给人类专家，同时自动化高置信度决策，提高临床人工智能的安全性。然而，这种安全机制完全依赖于不确定性分数准确反映临床模糊性的前提。在以严重类别不平衡为特征的预后任务中，感兴趣的临床结果是少数，这一假设失效。标准不确定性度量不再捕捉临床对齐的模糊性；相反，它们成为类别归属的代理，系统性地惩罚少数患者，无论其个体预测清晰度如何。结果。在56个合成条件和三个神经退行性队列（多发性硬化、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病）中，跨越严重类别不平衡到接近平衡的条件，我们的框架在轨迹上一致保持有界、平衡的风险。相比之下，全局指标要么使少数类敏感性崩溃，要么以牺牲多数患者为代价保护少数类。将CCR与标准熵结合未能保护少数类，因为当tau=0.5时它破坏了类内单调性。将CCR与阈值感知指标结合恢复了严格单调性，正确识别模糊患者，并安全减轻少数类排除。结论。在临床类别不平衡下，标准不确

extra.description: Background. Selective prediction systems improve the safety of clinical artificial intelligence by deferring ambiguous cases to human experts while automating high-confidence decisions. However, this safety mechanism relies entirely on the premise that uncertainty scores accurately reflect clinical ambiguity. In prognostic tasks characterized by severe class imbalance, where the clinical outcome of interest is a minority, this assumption breaks down. Standard uncertainty measures cease to capture clinically aligned ambiguity; instead, they become a proxy for class membership, systematically penalizing minority patients regardless of their individual predictive clarity. Results. Across 56 synthetic conditions and three neurodegenerative cohorts spanning severe class imbalance to near-balanced conditions (multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's Disease), our framework consistently maintained bounded, balanced risk across trajectories. In contrast, global metrics either collapsed minority Sensitivity or protected the minority at the expense of majority patients. Applying CCR with standard entropy fails to protect the minority because it breaks within-class monotonicity when tau=0.5. Combining CCR with threshold-aware metrics restores strict monotonicity, correctly identifies ambiguous patients, and safely mitigates minority exclusion. Conclusions. Under clinical class imbalance, standard uncertainty quantification measures dataset sparsity rather than clinical ambiguity, creating a systemic illusion of safety. This bias is a correctable structural flaw. Clinical pipelines deploying selective prediction under imbalance should adopt threshold-aligned uncertainty measures and class-stratified evaluation. This reduces class-specific risk imbalance, supporting safer selective prediction under the evaluated conditions without silently excluding the most vulnerable patients.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知和方向敏感表示学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞状态由内在基因表达程序和细胞所在的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这一背景变得可测量，但有效的表示学习需要同时捕获空间信息分子信号和细胞间组织。现有方法只能部分解决这些挑战：传统基因选择可能忽略空间结构化信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅邻近性，丢弃方向，要么依赖与任意组织框架绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但不同空间组织的细胞可能获得过于相似的表示，尽管它们经历着塑造其细胞状态的不同生物背景。我们介绍Tessera，一个空间表示学习框架，同时解决分子选择和细胞背景问题。Tessera将空间信息基因选择与几何归纳偏置相结合，将每个细胞置于其局部组织环境中。通过建模相对细胞-细胞关系，Tessera具有平移不变性同时保留方向，允许邻近细胞根据其空间背景和细胞状态做出不同贡献。在留出组织和技术上，Tessera在表示质量上优于现有空间基础模型，并零样本泛

extra.description: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Large-scale integrated single-cell analysis reveals molecular subtypes and microenvironmental remodeling in cutaneous T cell lymphoma
items.title_zh: 大规模整合单细胞分析揭示皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤的分子亚型和微环境重塑
items.summary_zh: 皮肤T细胞淋巴瘤（CTCL）包括一组临床和分子异质的皮肤归巢非霍奇金淋巴瘤，其稳健生物标志物仍然有限。先前的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）研究为CTCL生物学提供了重要见解，但许多先前研究受样本量小限制并聚焦于特定小众问题。此外，许多研究存在伪重复问题，导致检验统计量膨胀和外部效度降低。在此，我们汇集并整合了跨越244个独特样本和132名患者的scRNA-seq数据，涵盖CTCL、健康对照（HC）和良性炎症性皮肤病（BID）条件，生成了迄今最多样化的CTCL图谱。在识别恶性细胞群体和异质的样本内基因表达改变后，我们应用伪批量聚合和稳健线性混合效应建模来提名这一高度异质患者队列中的复发性变化。对皮肤微环境的探究识别了CTCL病变与对照病变相比以及跨疾病临床阶段的显著组成和细胞类型特异性表达变化。最后，我们使用无偏聚类识别了稳定的、分子定义的疾病亚型，其在独立数据集中预测结局。总之，本

extra.description: Cutaneous T cell lymphoma (CTCL) comprises a clinically and molecularly heterogeneous group of skin-homing non-Hodgkin lymphomas for which robust biomarkers remain limited. Prior single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) studies have provided important insights into CTCL biology, but many of these prior studies have been limited by small sample sizes and focused on niche questions of interest. Additionally, many studies have suffered from pseudoreplication, resulting in inflated test statistics and reduced external validity. Here, we assembled and integrated scRNA-seq data spanning 244 unique samples and 132 patients across CTCL, healthy control (HC), and benign inflammatory dermatoses (BID) conditions, generating the most diverse atlas of CTCL to date. Following identification of malignant cell populations and heterogeneous, within-sample gene expression alterations, we applied pseudobulk aggregation and robust linear mixed-effects modeling to nominate recurrent changes across this highly heterogeneous patient cohort. Interrogation of the skin microenvironment identified significant compositional and cell type-specific expression changes in CTCL lesions as compared to control lesions and across clinical stages of disease. Finally, we used unbiased clustering to identify stable, molecularly defined subtypes of disease that were predictive of outcome in an independent dataset. Together, this study provides a rigorous analysis of the most diverse scRNA-seq dataset of CTCL ever compiled, nominating specific alterations in cell type composition and gene expression across malignant cell and microenvironmental populations with significant clinical implications.

items.title: ProtAgent: Post-Training Compact Protein Tool Agents with Interaction-Level Credit Assignment
items.title_zh: ProtAgent：具有交互级信用分配的训练后紧凑蛋白质工具代理
items.summary_zh: 蛋白质注释代理必须选择合适的生物信息学工具，解释其输出，并在最终答案中使用所得证据。大多数现有系统依赖前沿规模模型。我们询问紧凑模型是否可以通过与真实工具交互的后训练来学习这种行为。我们提出ProtAgent，一个两阶段流水线，使用监督微调（SFT）学习工具接口，并使用标准同策略REINFORCE改进交互策略。中间工具调用获得动作奖励，最终响应获得终端答案奖励。步级回报将这些奖励分配给产生它们的响应以及之前的动作。回合级基线则为每个动作分配一个回合回报。在具有真实生物信息学工具的固定闭环协议上，ProtAgent-8B在注释覆盖率指标下达到61.00%的成功率，而DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B为41.60%，最强评估前沿系统为60.80%。在三种子比较中，在恒等回报归一化下，回合级回报的平均成功率为42.70%，步级回报为61.40%；相应的组相对结果分别为36.5

extra.description: Protein annotation agents must choose suitable bioinformatics tools, interpret their outputs, and use the resulting evidence in the final answer. Most existing systems rely on frontier-scale models. We ask whether a compact model can instead learn this behavior through post-training with real tool interaction. We present ProtAgent, a two-stage pipeline that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the tool interface and standard on-policy REINFORCE to improve the interaction policy. Intermediate tool calls receive action rewards, and the final response receives a terminal answer reward. Step-level returns assign these rewards to the responses that produced them and to preceding actions. The episode-level baseline instead assigns one episode return to every action. On a fixed closed-loop protocol with real bioinformatics tools, ProtAgent-8B achieves 61.00% success under the annotation-coverage metric, compared with 41.60% for DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B and 60.80% for the strongest evaluated frontier system. In the three-seed comparison, mean success is 42.70% with episode-level returns and 61.40% with step-level returns under identity return normalization; the corresponding group-relative results are 36.50% and 58.20%. The metric measures recovery of reference annotations under this protocol; it does not by itself establish biological correctness or complete evidence grounding.

items.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: VGL-stGen：学习肺组织学和空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
items.summary_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模态大语言模型，从预训练医学视觉-语言模型改编而来，使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督转移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞身份和观察到的基因表达组合进行条件表达完成。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件完成，固定查询基因身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适应表明，将监督限制在请求的表达水平标记上可以进一步改善图像条件完成。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学增加了超出观察表达的信息。外部分类部分依赖具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接

extra.description: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: RADAgent: Automating RADseq Pipelines with Private Open-Source LLMs
items.title_zh: RADAgent：用私有开源LLM自动化RADseq流水线
items.summary_zh: 限制性位点相关DNA测序（RADseq）是一类简化代表性测序方法。它使用限制性内切酶对基因组子集进行采样，从而允许以低成本对多个个体一起进行测序和基因分型。RADseq广泛用于种群基因组学、进化生物学、标记发现和SNP面板开发，但完整分析仍需要专家协调多个工具和处理阶段。传统的RADseq分析需要专家协调异构生物信息学工具、中间工件、质量控制检查以及跨多个阶段的参数依赖决策。虽然单个步骤可以脚本化，但执行完整工作流仍需要人工监督以进行状态跟踪、结果验证和故障处理。为了自动化这种专家驱动的协调，我们提出RADAgent，它引入了一种模块化代理方法，使用开放权重LLM可靠执行RADseq工作流。RADAgent将RADseq工作流的自然边界映射为16个独立可执行和可验证的代理模块，并使用模型无关的运行时进行有界工具执行、磁盘验证和故障恢复。我们在包含来自19个种群的476个样本的真实种群基因组

extra.description: Restriction site-associated DNA sequencing (RADseq) is a family of reduced-representation sequencing methods. It uses restriction enzymes to sample subsets of the genome, therefore allowing multiple individuals to be sequenced and genotyped together at low cost. RADseq is widely used for population genomics, evolutionary biology, marker discovery, and the development of SNP panels, but complete analysis still requires expert coordination across multiple tools and processing stages. Traditional RADseq analysis requires expert coordination of heterogeneous bioinformatics tools, intermediate artifacts, quality-control checks, and parameter-dependent decisions across multiple stages. Although individual steps can be scripted, executing the complete workflow still requires human oversight for state tracking, result validation, and failure handling. To automate this expert-driven coordination, we present RADAgent, which introduces a modular agentic method for reliable RADseq workflow execution with an open-weight LLM. RADAgent maps the natural boundaries of the RADseq workflow into 16 independently executable and verifiable agent modules and uses a model-independent runtime for bounded tool execution, on-disk verification, and failure recovery. We evaluate RADAgent on a real population-genomics dataset containing 476 samples from 19 populations. The results demonstrate that RADAgent reliably automates the complete RADseq workflow with an open-weight LLM while keeping genomic data and model execution within the local computing environment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wenlu-lab/RADAgent.

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
items.title_zh: 安全头部：学习到的注意力门控提升提示注入鲁棒性
items.summary_zh: 我们提出安全头部（HoS），一种提示注入防御方法，通过一小组学习到的逐头注意力门控来强制指令-数据分离。HoS学习每个头应如何在可信与不可信token之间重新分配注意力，使模型能够对不可信内容进行推理而不遵循注入的指令。我们在Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和GPT-OSS-20B上评估HoS。我们将其与SecAlign++（一种最先进的基于微调的防御）和ASIDE（一种与我们的方法类似、将指令-数据分离构建到模型架构中的防御）进行比较。我们表明，HoS对自适应攻击具有更强的鲁棒性，在标准效用基准上表现更好，并在标准智能体提示注入基准上达到顶级性能。更具体地说，黑盒RL-Hammer攻击对GPT-OSS-20B达到97%的攻击成功率，对SecAlign达到85%，但对HoS仅达到10%。Claudini是一种最先进的白盒攻击，通过自动研究针对HoS进行了增强，其在HoS上达到相

extra.description: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.

items.title: Attention as Lattice Gauge Theory: Relations Interact Only Through Wilson Loops
items.title_zh: 注意力作为格点规范理论：关系仅通过Wilson环相互作用
items.summary_zh: 关系通过它们共享的实体进行组合——Alice是Bob的母亲，Bob是Carol的父亲，所以Alice是Carol的祖母——而且顺序很重要，因为父亲的母亲不是母亲的父亲；验证组合关系意味着闭合环路。我们表明，如果每个实体的坐标框架可以独立旋转（逐实体框架自由度），则有三件事随之而来。在纯规范扇区中，不共享任何循环的关系完全不能相互作用。三角形的唯一规范不变评分是其完整群$H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$的类函数——一个Wilson环。而边的唯一等变更新是$U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$，其中$Ψ$是共轭等变的。因此，通过Wilson环进行的边注意力不是众多设计之一，而是对称性所允许的唯一形式。三个社区持有这种形式的部分内容：知识图谱的交换算子嵌入是其阿贝尔（交换）扇区；AlphaFold的三角形更新和Edge Transformer具有其形状——通过第三个顶点更新边—

extra.description: Relations compose through the entity they share - Alice is Bob's mother and Bob is Carol's father, so Alice is Carol's grandmother - and the order matters, since a father's mother is not a mother's father; verifying a composed relation means closing the loop. We show that if each entity's coordinate frame may be rotated independently (per-entity frame freedom), three things follow. In the pure-gauge sector, relations that share no cycle cannot interact at all. The only gauge-invariant score of a triangle is a class function of its holonomy $H = T_{ij} T_{jk} T_{ki}$ - a Wilson loop. And the only equivariant update of an edge is $U = Ψ(H)\, T_{ij}$ with $Ψ$ conjugation-equivariant. Edge attention by Wilson loops is therefore not one design among many but the unique form the symmetry permits. Three communities hold pieces of this form: the commuting-operator embeddings of knowledge graphs are its abelian (commuting) sector; AlphaFold's triangle update and the Edge Transformer have its shape - an edge updated through the third vertex - without its constraints; and lattice QCD builds it equivariantly on lattices. We instantiate the equivariant sub-family on general relational graphs as holonomy attention. With no training and composition alone, it infers unobserved $S_4$ relations on sparse graphs at 0.88 with a fifth of the edges corrupted, at or slightly below specialist synchronization algorithms, where every commutative architecture is capped at 0.083; its holonomy score flags corrupted triangles at AUC 0.99 where commuting scores are capped at 0.76 by a second selection rule, and it separates clusters without labels.

items.title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
items.title_zh: KPPax：为大气化学中的机器学习预处理可微动力学ODE
items.summary_zh: 大气化学机理通常以动力学预处理器（KPP）语言分发，该语言生成高效的Fortran或C代码，但不适合开发机器学习模型所用的可微编程框架。我们提出KPPax，一种动力学预处理器，可从KPP语言编写的机理生成JAX中可微、即时编译且可向量化的化学代码。KPPax在对数空间中使用稀疏操作评估速率定律，保持其可微性，并使用\texttt{diffrax}库的隐式求解器和前向及反向模式伴随来积分刚性系统，从而无需手工推导伴随代码即可获得精确灵敏度。我们使用POLLU基准机理演示了两个应用。在第一个中，从自动微分雅可比矩阵计算的Fisher信息矩阵在任何拟合之前预测流动管式设计可以识别25个速率系数中的哪些，噪声合成估计确认了九个可识别速率系数的预测不确定性在约30%以内，同时揭示了仅受比率约束的快速反应簇。在第二个中，排放清单的神经网络校正首先在逐场景4D-Var反演上离线训练，然后通过化学模型在线

extra.description: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in log space, which keeps it differentiable, and integrates the stiff system with the implicit solvers and the forward- and reverse-mode adjoints of the \texttt{diffrax} library, so that exact sensitivities are obtained without hand-derived adjoint code. We demonstrate two applications with the POLLU benchmark mechanism. In the first, the Fisher information matrix computed from an automatically differentiated Jacobian predicts, before any fit, which of the 25 rate coefficients a flow-tube-like design can identify, and noisy synthetic estimation confirms the predicted uncertainties of the nine identifiable rate coefficients to within about 30\% while revealing clusters of fast reactions of which only ratios are constrained. In the second, a neural-network correction of an emission inventory is trained offline on per-scenario 4D-Var retrievals and then fine-tuned online through the chemical model, which reduces the error of the biogenic correction by a factor of 2.4--5 and recovers information on low-temperature emissions that the individual retrievals lose. KPPax makes KPP mechanisms directly usable for parameter estimation and hybrid physics--machine-learning modelling.

items.title: Scaling Laws for Tool-Use Agents via Controllable Environment Synthesis
items.title_zh: 工具使用智能体的缩放定律：通过可控环境合成
items.summary_zh: 我们探索如何构建能够完成复杂多步任务的高性能大语言模型（LLM）工具使用智能体。具体而言，我们研究合成生成的工具使用环境中的数据组成如何影响此类智能体的训练。为此，我们提出SynthAPI流水线，它沿工具、任务以及工具所操作的数据库等维度显式控制生成环境的多样性。通过在458,752个任务中系统地变化SynthAPI的生成控制，并训练四种不同规模的849个模型，我们推导出一个缩放定律，根据合成环境的规模和组成预测下游工具使用智能体的泛化能力。这些可预测的关系揭示了扩展工具使用智能体数据的若干经验。随着数据预算增长，扩展工具和数据库多样性比增加任务数量更有效，而增加数据复杂性会产生更大收益。根据这些发现进行扩展，所得到的智能体在四个评估基准上优于使用先前工作数据训练的大规模工具使用智能体和合成环境生成模型。

extra.description: We explore how to build performant large language model (LLM) tool-use agents that complete complex, multi-step tasks. Specifically, we study how data composition in synthetically generated tool-use environments affects the training of such agents. To do so, we propose the SynthAPI pipeline, which explicitly controls the diversity of generated environments along the axes of tools, tasks, and the databases on which the tools operate. By systematically varying SynthAPI's generation controls in 458,752 tasks across 849 trained models of four different sizes, we derive a scaling law that predicts downstream tool-use agent generalization based on the scale and composition of the synthesized environments. These predictable relationships reveal several lessons for scaling tool-use agent data. As data budgets grow, scaling tool and database diversity becomes more effective than increasing the number of tasks, and increasing data complexity yields larger gains. Scaling according to these findings yields agents that outperform models trained on data from prior work in large-scale tool-use agent and synthetic environment generation across four evaluation benchmarks.

items.title: Mathematical genomics of SRY proteins and their associated HMG-Box domains across mammals

extra.description: Male sex determination in mammals depends on sex-determining region Y (SRY), a transcription factor whose high-mobility group box (HMG box) binds and bends DNA to activate SOX9. The divergent N- and C-terminal domains lack sequence homology and have been dismissed as passive linkers, yet alignment-based homology cannot reveal whether they retain a hidden compositional grammar. We applied quantitative genomics to 65 full-length mammalian SRY proteins and 38 HMG-box subsequences across 75 mammals, integrating amino acid and dipeptide compositions, Shannon entropy, dominant-residue profiles, hydropathy-based n-gram spectra, longest hydropathy stretches, and cumulative proximity. The HMG box is tightly constrained: basic residues dominated, cysteine was nearly absent, entropy clustered near 4.0, polar content averaged 58.44\%, and 25 of 38 HMG boxes shared 57.97\% polar residues, whereas full-length SRY varied more, with rodents showing high polar and glutamine-rich profiles and cetaceans low polar content. Proximity-based clustering was more taxonomically consistent at the HMG level, while terminal regions blurred domain-level signals. Across 65 SRY proteins and 38 HMG domains, intrinsic disorder was the dominant predicted state, and a polyQ-rich rodent SRY illustrated how low-complexity repeats can produce misleading ordered predictions, underscoring the need for consensus disorder analysis in rapidly evolving intrinsically disordered regions. Cumulative proximity analysis identified \textit{Bos taurus} and \textit{Bos grunniens} as the only pair proximally clustered at both the full-length SRY and SRY-HMG levels, establishing multivariate proximity as a stringent criterion of compositional similarity satisfied by a single mammalian pair. These results suggest that SRY and its HMG box each carry a distinct compositional grammar, quantifiable only through alignment-independent signatures, with compositional individuality being the rule rather than the exception. These quantitative signatures provide a framework for interpreting SRY variation, assessing clinical mutations, and understanding evolutionary pressures shaping sex determination. Denser taxon sampling, structural modeling, and experimental tests are needed to clarify whether HMG-box drift and terminal-region variation affect DNA binding, bending, or reproductive function.

items.title: 华为制药军团表态，其公司定位是医药行业的AI赋能者，而不是跟大家抢着做药，意味着什么？背后有哪些考量？
items.title_zh: 华为制药军团表态，其公司定位是医药行业的AI赋能者，而不是跟大家抢着做药，意味着什么？背后有哪些考量？
items.summary_zh: 记者 张英 自2025年底开始，华为制药军团开始出现在各大医药行业论坛。华为也要做药吗？这是不少医药人的疑问。 “我们不做药。”2026年10月24日，在第十一届医药创新与投资大会上，华为制药军团总裁樊杰明确回应。 他介绍，华为制药军团的定位是医药行业的AI赋能者，而不是跟大家抢着做药。华为来自计算机通信领域，并非生物、化学领域，所以着重发挥自己的特长。 樊杰认为，相比其他公司，华为参与AI制药有三大优势： 首先，华为具备算力和存力，尤其是可以提供许多企业没有的先进算力； 第二是算力的集群能力，这关系到如何充分发挥算力，如何用大算力加大数据得出一个更好的结果。训练模型至少需要64张卡，很多时候甚至是百卡和千卡规模。但是几百张卡不能单独一张一张用，需要串起来形成集群，华为在集群化、超节点上有独特优势。当前华为有1024卡的超节点方案，在全球是最大的； 第三是生态优势。华为与深势科技、望石智慧

items.title_zh: 姆巴佩在道歉声明中说「ill-judged」，这个词具体什么意思？体现出诚意了吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，效力于西甲皇家马德里俱乐部的法国球员姆巴佩发表涉华不当言论。北京时间10月27日，姆巴佩发布道歉声明。 英文原文提到：My comment was ill-judged, and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world. 我的言论欠妥，如今我明白，这些话伤害了中国以及世界各地华人社区的许多人。 在相关热搜词条下，有不少网友指出，其道歉声明措辞“缺乏诚意”。 28日，“中国日报双语新闻”引用公众号“英文悦读”文章指出，这封道歉信读起来更像是一份公关模板文，经过了大量模糊化和去责任化的处理，但诚意是明显不足的。 文章作者魏剑峰分析认为，My comment was ill-judged，其中ill-judged的英文释义是：showing

items.title: 餐馆「三五而栗」全门店将停业，曾因优先招聘35岁以上及残障人士出圈，问题出在哪？善意和盈利该怎么平衡？
items.title_zh: 餐馆「三五而栗」全门店将停业，曾因优先招聘35岁以上及残障人士出圈，问题出在哪？善意和盈利该怎么平衡？
items.summary_zh: 10月21日，三湘都市报记者获悉，长沙本土餐饮品牌 “三五而栗” 发布通告，旗下所有门店计划于10月底停止经营。品牌运营一年多来，因优先招录残障人士、35 岁以上就业困难群体，受到不少市民关注。 创始人易北介绍，品牌创办之初，希望打造标准化、可复制的良心门店，为残障人士、中年就业困难群体提供稳定岗位。团队最初的设想是，在保本运营的基础上稳步拓店、打磨运营模式，持续释放就业岗位，待模式成熟后带动更多同类群体创业。 通告表示，运营过程中，品牌坚持给到员工优厚保障：门店包三餐，宿舍以单人间为主，少量双人间；员工入职即缴纳五险一金，平均薪资高于长沙餐饮行业平均水平，休息安排也优于行业常规。经过两年实践，综合食材、房租、人力、前期拓店与产品研发投入等多重运营因素考量，团队审慎评估后，决定暂停所有门店运营。 “想为就业困难群体撑起一片小天地的探索，暂时告一段落。” 易北表示，这段旅程收获了许多温暖，助

items.title: 皇马拒绝西甲对姆巴佩事件的帮助，有皇马高管甚至在看笑话，双方关系为何如此紧张？这场风波会加剧矛盾吗？
items.title_zh: 皇马拒绝西甲对姆巴佩事件的帮助，有皇马高管甚至在看笑话，双方关系为何如此紧张？这场风波会加剧矛盾吗？
items.summary_zh: 法国《队报》报道，西甲联赛方面曾提出帮助皇马解决姆巴佩事件带来的影响，但皇马拒绝了。 据报道，前一天西甲联赛曾警告皇家马德里即将面临一场争议，并准备帮助这家马德里俱乐部解决此事。然而，鉴于双方关系糟糕，皇家马德里断然拒绝了西甲的帮助。尽管俱乐部与中国民营企业的合同并未受到影响，但俱乐部本身却不可避免地会受到波及，尤其是在中国市场的球衣销售方面，因为姆巴佩的名字和号码此前一直是中国最受欢迎的。 幕后，一些皇家马德里的高管甚至对这种情况感到好笑，很好奇特瓦斯会如何应对。然而，姆巴佩的团队却笑不出来，周二他们接到无数电话。同时，皇马主席弗洛伦蒂诺密切关注着事态发展。在法国，从法国足协到外交层面，电话都响个不停。法国足协表示正在密切关注事态发展，并强调“目前与中国合作伙伴的合同涉及整个法国国家队”。队报：皇马拒绝了西甲对姆巴佩事件的帮助；皇马高层想看特瓦斯笑话_腾讯新闻

items.title: 美联储宣布维持基准利率不变，背后的核心考量是什么？对市场将产生哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 美联储宣布维持基准利率不变，背后的核心考量是什么？对市场将产生哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 新华社纽约10月28日电（记者刘亚南 徐静）美国联邦储备委员会28日结束为期两天的货币政策会议，宣布将联邦基金利率目标区间维持在3.75%至4%不变。这一决定符合市场此前广泛预期。 联邦公开市场委员会以10:2的投票结果作出这一决定，美联储理事莉萨·库克和美国克利夫兰联储银行行长贝丝·哈马克在投票中主张继续加息25个基点。 美联储在声明中表示，通胀仍处于高位，累积更多信息将有助于委员会确定合适的货币政策，以确保通胀回落到2%的目标水平。 声明说，虽然地缘政治局势等不确定性依然很高，但国内支出保持韧性，生产力增长和资本投资强劲。新增就业与劳动力供给保持同步，失业率变化很小。 美联储主席沃什在28日午后举行的记者会上说，自9月份加息以来，一些企业和家庭的金融和信贷条件收紧，不过整体金融条件并未达到紧张程度，这将有助于稳定物价。他还称，此次货币政策会议上没有人提及即将到来的国会中期选举。 因近期

items.title: 村民为悬挂婚庆气球在水库大坝公路钻数十个孔，水务局责令拆除，这对大坝有多大危害？钻洞行为违法吗？
items.title_zh: 村民为悬挂婚庆气球在水库大坝公路钻数十个孔，水务局责令拆除，这对大坝有多大危害？钻洞行为违法吗？
items.summary_zh: “玉龙湖水库大坝公路是否可以随意钻孔，安装空飘气球，是不是违规了？”近日，有网友通过“四川省网上群众工作平台——问政四川”反映，其在泸州市泸县玉龙湖水库附近走亲戚时，偶遇周边居民办婚宴，“他们在大坝公路上钻了不少孔洞，放了很多空飘庆贺气球。这会不会损坏大坝，造成安全隐患？相关部门应该管管。” “大概有二十多个气球，每个气球下边有一个铁板固定底座，每个底座下至少打两个孔，用螺丝拧紧固定”，该网友质疑，“钻那么多洞是否符合规定，是否需要进行审批？随意打孔，会不会造成大坝不稳定，存在安全问题？” 对此，泸县水务局回应，10月4日下午水库大坝附近有村民办酒席，为酒席营造氛围，村民私自在三溪口水库（玉龙湖水库）二副坝公路上钻孔安装了空飘气球。水库大坝巡查人员发现后，立即叫停操作并责令马上拆除。 泸县水务局表示，根据《水库大坝安全管理条例》第十三条“禁止在大坝管理和保护范围内进行爆破、打井、采石、采矿

items.title: 西班牙高铁事故已致68死，相撞时车速超100公里/时，系人为失误，暴露什么问题？防撞系统为啥没起作用？
items.title_zh: 西班牙高铁事故已致68死，相撞时车速超100公里/时，系人为失误，暴露什么问题？防撞系统为啥没起作用？
items.summary_zh: 西班牙首都马德里与安达卢西亚之间的高速铁路28日发生两辆列车相撞事故。事发地位于马德里以南的托莱多附近。托莱多所在的卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查自治区政府通报称，截至目前，事故已造成至少68人遇难，数十人受伤。救援行动仍在继续，根据当地报告，伤亡人数或将进一步上升。 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查自治区主席埃米利亚诺·加西亚-帕赫28日表示，此次事故遇难者人数已上升至68人，数十人受伤，死亡人数可能还会增加。另据中国驻西班牙大使馆消息，相撞列车上有4名中国公民，1人腿部受轻伤。更多资讯请下载央视新闻客户端 西班牙卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查自治区政府28日说，当天上午在其首府托莱多发生的高速铁路列车相撞事故死亡人数上升至64人。初步调查显示，事故系人为调度失误所致。 由于救援人员在推进至受损车厢内部及坍塌残骸深处时发现了更多尸体，官方明确表示遇难者人数还将继续上升。西班牙列车相撞事故已致64人死亡 初步调查指向调度失误

items.title: 科普书出现「双头虾」图片，出版社称正在下架召回，为何出现如此明显错误？科普类出版该限制 AI 配图吗？
items.title_zh: 科普书出现「双头虾」图片，出版社称正在下架召回，为何出现如此明显错误？科普类出版该限制 AI 配图吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，有网友在社交平台指出，《南海海洋生物科普丛书》中有“双头虾”的错误图片，引发关注。 有读者在社交平台反映，其购入中国农业出版社出版发行的《南海海洋生物科普丛书》，丛书序言表示，本套丛书里绝大多数图片由AI绘图工具生成。但其发现丛书的绘图中出现了“双头虾”的错误图片，分别在第13册“斑节对虾”封面与内页。 读者质疑称，在以往的认知里，图文并茂的书需要大量实拍图或手绘图，AI的出现大大减少了工作量。“不是说不能用AI，但总要遵守一下基本的法则吧。这下好了，双头虾都出来了，快去申报养殖新品种吧。” 10月27日，中国农业出版社工作人员告诉南都N视频记者，出版社已经关注到相关情况。该出版社读者服务热线的工作人员向记者表示，目前正在通知全网下架并召回涉事图书。 科普书现“双头虾”图片，中国农业出版社回应：正通知全网下架，召回涉事图书_腾讯新闻 “双头虾”配图 有读者在社交平台反映，其购入中国农
